name: list what only a human can check
about: The checks a person has to do by hand, listed for them just before the merge gate, in the format `sb presets design-gate` prints — head yours for what it is. Include only what no agent could verify — end-to-end flows needing a real device or session, and UI that is new or visibly changed. Name the route and what should be seen there: which screens to open, which controls to exercise. Exclude everything already covered, always: logic under test, queries an agent ran itself, untouched UI — repeating a check that passed asks a person to redo an agent's work. No filler, no restating the diff. If nothing genuinely needs a human, say so and skip with that reason. Put the same list in this step's `output`, because that is what the PR comment dumps: whoever reviews the PR sees the manual checks there rather than having to find the agent that wrote them. A skip goes in `output` too, as the one line saying why nothing here needs a person; `why` carries it for the board. This list exists to shorten review-to-ship, and every line that does not need a person lengthens it. Obliged by `merge`: it appears with every merge step named from the library, and it may be skipped with a reason — a one-line docs change needs no manual pass — but never left out. PREPARED BEFORE THE PR, NOT AFTER, so the human meets it the first time they read the comment. It is the change record's `human_checks`, and a change with nothing here says so — the explicit `Nothing — agent verification covers this change` is a real answer.
